notes: §1985:X.5.2.4 GR13: if BY REFERENCE is 'either specified or implied for a parameter, the object program operates as if the corresponding data item in the called program occupies the same storage area as the data item in the calling program', the descriptions to 'describe the same number of character positions' (a requirement on the source). CallBinder.BindCall carries the prevailing mode across the following parameters with BY REFERENCE assumed before the first phrase (GR12), and CallEmitter.CrossingOf/RefCarrier with ProgramEmitter.FormalCrossing/FormalAdopt alias the callee's formal to the caller's storage. Probes: (b) implied and explicit BY REFERENCE, BY CONTENT A BY REFERENCE B C D and the reverse (only the reference parameters changed in the caller), a literal, ADDRESS OF and an empty BY REFERENCE refused at 85; (a/d/f) S9(18) with SIZE ERROR, COMP-3, S9(5) COMP, TE(I) with I changed by the callee, W(2:3), an ODO group, X(4)->9(4), 9(3)V9->9(4) and group->X(4) all share storage; (e) a record of a file whose OPEN failed. The witness (implied then explicit BY REFERENCE, X(5) to a 2+3 group formal) prints AAAAA/CCCCC/BBBBB/ZZCCC.

next.reason: 1985: BY REFERENCE (specified or implied) means the called item 'occupies the same storage area', and its description 'must describe the same number of character positions'. Storage sharing is kept (§2023:14.2.3 GR8; §2023:8.6.7 GR3 'establishes a common data item'). The length rule differs: §2023:14.8.2.3.2 keeps 'the formal parameter shall be of the same length as the corresponding argument' only for elementary items in a plain CALL (matching ALIGN/PICTURE/USAGE clauses for prototyped or NESTED calls), while for an alphanumeric group §2023:14.8.2.2 SR1 allows 'the same number or a smaller number of bytes' and requires the other operand to be a group or alphanumeric item (a group argument with an equal-size numeric formal, legal in 1985, now violates). §2023:13.7.3 SR3 and §2023:14.9.4.3 SR25 apply these rules, and §2023:14.9.4.4 GR3d sets EC-PROGRAM-ARG-MISMATCH on a detected violation.
